'''Oakie Dokes''' was a member of the [[Swokes Swokes]] [[species]]<ref name="Lists" /> who had pale skin and [[Color|red]] [[eye]]s. When the [[bounty hunter]] [[Zam Wesell]] crashed her [[Koro-2 all-environment Exodrive airspeeder]] into one of the streets of the [[Uscru Entertainment District]] on the [[planet]] [[Coruscant]]<ref name="AOTC">{{Film|II}}</ref> in [[22 BBY]],<ref name="Date">''[[Star Wars: Galactic Atlas]]'' dates the events of {{Film|II}} to [[22 BBY]].</ref> Dokes was among the passersby who crowded around the wreckage of the [[airspeeder]].<ref name="AOTC" />

Wesell managed to escape from the [[Repulsorcraft|vessel]] and fled into the nearby [[Outlander Club]], which Dokes also entered. When the [[Jedi]] [[Anakin Skywalker]] and [[Obi-Wan Kenobi]] entered the club in search of Wesell, Dokes was stood near the bar while speaking to a [[human]]. While on Coruscant, Dokes wore a black [[Clothing|dress]] with a large red collar.<ref name="AOTC" />

==Behind the scenes==
{{Quote|We've got a really good date for you. We've fixed you up.|George Lucas jokingly introduces Anthony Daniels to his "date"|<ref name="Webisode">{{SW|url=video/a-twinkle-beyond-pluto|series=Making Episode II Webdocs|text=Part 5: A Twinkle Beyond Pluto}}</ref>}}
Oakie Dokes first appeared in the [[2002]] [[prequel trilogy]] film, [[Star Wars: Episode II Attack of the Clones|''Star Wars'': Episode II ''Attack of the Clones'']].<ref name="AOTC" /> Dokes was portrayed by an extra,<ref name="Webisode" /> with both scenes filmed in [[Fox Studios, Sydney]].<ref name="Mythmaking">''[[Mythmaking: Behind the Scenes of Attack of the Clones]]''</ref> The nightclub interior scene was filmed on Stage 3 on [[July 17]], [[2000]].<ref name="365Days">''[[Creating the Worlds of Star Wars: 365 Days]]''</ref> On set, director [[George Lucas]] joked that Dokes was the on-screen date for actor [[Anthony Daniels]],<ref name="Webisode" /> who was playing club patron [[Dannl Faytonni]] in the scene.<ref name="Complete Locations">[[Star Wars: Complete Locations (2016)|''Star Wars: Complete Locations'']]</ref> In the current ''[[Star Wars]]'' [[canon]], Dokes was first identified in the [[2020]] reference book ''[[Star Wars: Book of Lists]]'', which was written by [[Cole Horton]].<ref name="Lists" />

The [[Oakie Dokes/Legends|name]] originated in the [[Star Wars Legends|''Star Wars'' Legends]] continuity, where it was first used on [[May 1]], [[2003]] in an image caption as part of the [[Image Attack]] feature on [[StarWars.com]].<ref name="ImageAttack">{{SWArchive|url=episode-ii/explore/attack/2003/05/imageattack20030501.html|series=Image Attack|text=Oakie Dokes the Swokes Swokes}}</ref> The character was named for [[Sue Oakes]],<ref name="Lists" /> as was the entire Swokes Swokes species.<ref name="MakingOfTPM">''[[Star Wars: The Making of Episode I The Phantom Menace]]''</ref> Oakes is the wife of [[Nick Dudman]], the Live Action Creature Effects Supervisor on the [[1999]] film [[Star Wars: Episode I The Phantom Menace|''Star Wars'': Episode I ''The Phantom Menace'']].<ref name="Lists" />
